description: FamilySearch record_read for the 1812 Bitton, Gloucestershire christening of Betty Martin (GKR7-4TQ2) — the hit returned by record-search-martin-betty-christening-hit. Names father Thomas Martin and mother Sophia Martin, which is what makes this record answer the plan item (it fixes the birth year AND names the parents). Paired with that search fixture because SKILL.md Step 5 requires record_read on any hit before handing off to record-extraction, and record_read is NOT in mock_mcp.LIVE_TOOLS: without this fixture the tool is never registered and the call aborts the run Type 1 (unmatched_tool_call, exit 2, corpus issue) instead of being graded. Predicate is a substring match on the entity ID so it fires whether the skill passes the bare recordId or the full ARK. Sophia is deliberately absent from the scenario's input files — she is a finding this record delivers, not something the skill starts with.

sources.citation: "England, Gloucestershire Parish Registers, 1538-1813," database with images, FamilySearch, entry for Betty Martin, christened 1 November 1812, Bitton, Gloucestershire, England; citing Bitton parish register.
